about: PEP 263 source-encoding vectors shared by the Go and Python tests (Round 6, WS-E1). Generated by gen_pep263_vectors.py on the reference interpreter; never edited by hand.
policy: Owner decision D2 (default 'expect'): plain/transparent -> every reader evaluates; foreign -> the Python engine decodes, Semgrep and secrets record lost evaluation; unknown -> lost everywhere; refused -> any outcome. 'expect_under_d2a' is the corrected D2-A (OWNER-DECISIONS §0.8): only takeover-immune spellings stay UTF-8-equivalent. A taken-over, non-immune name (takeover-* vectors) is D2's documented false clean ('d2_documented_false_clean'), asserted lost only under D2-A (OR-59). No outcome may crash the Python engine (OR-53). Paths measured: import (compile(bytes)+exec), script, and python -x (OR-49).

outcomes.evaluated: the reader does not record the file as lost evaluation
outcomes.lost: the reader records the file as lost evaluation (Semgrep: not parsed; secrets: unreadable; Python engine: AnalysisIncomplete names it)
outcomes.not_target: the reader does not select the file; it must not record it as lost
outcomes.finding: the Python engine reports python_engine_finding at the target
outcomes.decoded: the Python engine analyses the file and does not record it as lost
outcomes.crashed: an exception escaped the Python engine: never an allowed outcome, since it costs every other file (OR-53)
